question: Who was honoured with the 'Satyajit Ray Lifetime Achievement Award' at the West Bengal Film Journalists Association annual award ceremony?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aparna Sen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Aparna Sen**, a renowned director, was honored with the **Satyajit Ray Lifetime Achievement Award** at the **West Bengal Film Journalists Association (WBFJA)** annual ceremony for her significant contributions to Indian cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• During her acceptance speech, **Sen** expressed gratitude and praised **contemporary Bengali filmmakers** such as **Srijit Mukherji** and **Atanu Ghosh** for carrying forward the rich legacy of Bengali cinema.
 
• **‘Manikbabur Megh’** won the **Best Bengali Film** award, and **Chandan Sen** received the **Best Actor** award for his performance in the film.
 
• **Srijit Mukherji** and **Debaloy Bhattacharya** were jointly awarded **Best Director** for their films **‘Badami Haynar Kabale’** and **‘Padatik’**. Mukherji's film **‘Oti Uttam’** received **Special Recognition for Technical Innovation**, with a special focus on the use of AI to replicate the voice of iconic actor Uttam Kumar.
 
• **Rituparna Sengupta** won **Best Actor** for her role in **‘Ajogya’**. **Abhinandan Banerjee** was named **Most Promising Director** for **‘Manik Babur Megh’**.
 
• **‘Khadaan’** received the **Most Popular Film** award, and **Dev** was named **Most Popular Actor**.
 
• **Anjan Dutt** won the **Best Screenplay** award for his work on **‘Chalchitra Ekhon’**.
 
• Other notable winners included **Amit Chatterjee** (Best Music Director), **Rathijit Bhattacharya** (Best Background Score), and **Kaushik Ganguly** (Best Lyricist for ‘Ajogya’).
 
• **Playback singer awards** went to **Timir Biswas**, **Rathijit Bhattacharya**, and **Antara Mitra**.
 
• The ceremony, held at **Priya Cinema**, paid tribute to **Raj Kapoor** on his **birth centenary**, with a theme around the circus industry, and featured the iconic song **‘Jeena Yahan Marna Yahan’** from **Mera Naam Joker**.
